Support Our Work

Every contribution fuels our fight against female genital mutilation, child labour, and human trafficking — and helps us build a safer, fairer Nigeria for women and children.

Why Your Support Matters

Gender Frontier Development Initiatives (GFDI) is a grassroots advocacy organization committed to defending the human rights of vulnerable women and children in Nigeria. From campaigning against harmful traditional practices to intervening in crisis situations, our work is powered by people like you.

Protect Children

Help us end child labour, human trafficking, and female genital mutilation in vulnerable communities across Nigeria.

Empower Women

Fund outreach, education, and advocacy that gives women the autonomy to shape their own futures without fear.

Drive Change

Support community development projects, entrepreneurship programmes, and grassroots interventions that create lasting impact.

The Reality on the Ground

In Nigeria, millions of women and children face violations that most of the world never sees. These are not abstract statistics — they are real lives, in real communities, right now.

FGM Still Happens Daily

Despite laws against it, female genital mutilation continues in communities where tradition outweighs enforcement. Girls as young as infants are cut — many with no say, no voice, and no recourse.

Children Are Forced to Work

Children are pulled out of classrooms and into farms, markets, mines, and homes — losing their childhood to labour that robs them of education, safety, and dignity.

Trafficking Preys on the Vulnerable

Young women and girls are lured with false promises of work or marriage, then trapped in modern slavery — sometimes across borders, sometimes just down the road.

GFDI exists to push back against all of it. We educate. We intervene. We advocate. We stand with survivors. And none of that is possible without support from people who care.

Where Your Donation Goes

Every naira is put to work directly in the communities we serve. Here's what your contribution helps fund.

Community Education & Awareness

Workshops, town halls, and school programmes that teach communities about the harm of FGM, child labour, and trafficking — and offer alternatives rooted in local culture.

Direct Intervention & Rescue

Coordinating with partners to identify at-risk children and women, intervening in crisis situations, and connecting survivors to safe shelter, medical care, and legal support.

Legal Advocacy & Case Follow-Up

Working with legal practitioners to pursue justice for survivors, follow up on reported cases, and pressure institutions to enforce existing protections.

Women's Empowerment Initiatives

Skills training, entrepreneurship support, and micro-grants that give women economic independence — the surest path out of cycles of abuse.

Child Protection & Education

Helping children stay in school, covering fees for the most vulnerable, and providing supplies and mentorship that keep them off the streets and out of exploitative work.

Survivor Support Services

Counselling, rehabilitation, and ongoing case management for survivors — because recovery is a long road that doesn't end when the rescue does.

Transparency & Accountability

We believe that trust is earned. Every donation we receive is treated as a public trust — a mandate to act, not a privilege to hold.

GFDI is committed to full transparency in how funds are used. We document our interventions, track our outreach, and maintain clear records of every project we run. If you donate, you have every right to know where your money went and what it accomplished.

If you'd like more details about our projects, our partners, or how specific donations are allocated, we welcome you to reach out directly. Donors are partners, not ATMs.
